no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Scorpius Holdings is a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) operating through Scorpius Biomanufacturing, Inc. The company divested all clinical-stage oncology assets (HS-110 and PTX-35) during 2023 and divested Elusys Therapeutics (ANTHIM anthrax antitoxin) in December 2023. As of the FY2024 10-K, the company has no active proprietary clinical pipeline; its operations are services-only (process development and CGMP biomanufacturing for third-party customers). NYSE American suspended trading in April 2025; shares now trade OTC.
